display.purpose: Rendered note titles in preview only.

title.purpose: The note title in the editor header.

body.purpose: Rendered note content and UI copy; 72ch measure.

label.purpose: Sidebar section labels and panel headings; uppercase, tracked +0.08em.

mono.purpose: Machine-produced data only: times, counts, IDs, station labels, markdown source.

shadows.name: popover
shadows.purpose: Transient overlays (settings popover) above the chrome. The only shadow in the system.

motion.name: transition-ui
motion.purpose: Hover/focus state changes on controls and rows.

motion.name: service-run
motion.purpose: The one authored moment: a paper dash travels the syncing segment of the sync line.

motion.name: station-pulse
motion.purpose: Pulses the active station while syncing.

motion.name: reduced-motion
motion.value: prefers-reduced-motion: reduce disables service-run and station-pulse
motion.purpose: Accessibility floor; content is visible by default, never gated behind animation.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The single action class for committing moves: New note, Unlock vault.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { background: var(--color-route-blue); color: var(--color-paper); font-family: var(--font-sans, 'Overpass', sans-serif); font-size: 12.5px; font-weight: 600; padding: 6px 10px; border: none; border-radius: 6px; transition: opacity 100ms ease-out; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { opacity: 0.9; } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--color-route-blue); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Secondary Button
components.description: All non-committing actions; adapts border to paper or navy chrome.
components.css: .ds-btn-secondary { background: transparent; color: var(--color-ink-navy); font-family: var(--font-sans, 'Overpass', sans-serif); font-size: 12.5px; font-weight: 500; padding: 6px 10px; border: 1px solid var(--color-hairline-strong); border-radius: 6px; transition: background-color 100ms ease-out; } .ds-btn-secondary:hover { background: var(--color-paper-sunken); } .ds-btn-secondary:disabled { opacity: 0.5; }

components.name: Tag Chip
components.description: Small metadata pill for tags; never a control at rest.
components.css: .ds-chip-tag { display: inline-block; background: var(--color-paper); color: var(--color-ink-soft); border: 1px solid var(--color-hairline-strong); border-radius: 999px; padding: 2px 8px; font-family: var(--font-sans, 'Overpass', sans-serif); font-size: 11px; }

components.name: Search Field
components.description: Chrome-situated global search with mono kbd hint; the only dark input.
components.html: ⌘K
components.css: .ds-input-wrap { position: relative; display: inline-block; } .ds-input-search { height: 32px; width: 320px; background: var(--color-navy-deep); color: var(--color-paper); border: 1px solid var(--color-navy-line); border-radius: 6px; padding: 0 44px 0 32px; font-family: var(--font-sans, 'Overpass', sans-serif); font-size: 13px; caret-color: var(--color-violet); } .ds-input-search:focus { border-color: var(--color-route-blue); outline: none; } .ds-input-search::placeholder { color: var(--color-navy-text); } .ds-kbd { position: absolute; right: 8px; top: 8px; font-family: var(--font-mono, monospace); font-size: 10px; color: var(--color-navy-text); border: 1px solid var(--color-navy-line); border-radius: 4px; padding: 1px 6px; }

components.name: Sidebar Nav Row
components.description: Notebook/tag row with right-aligned mono count; active row carries the violet selection tint and 1px violet edge.
components.css: .ds-nav-row { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; width: 100%; height: 32px; padding: 0 8px; background: transparent; border: 1px solid transparent; border-radius: 6px; color: var(--color-ink-navy); font-family: var(--font-sans, 'Overpass', sans-serif); font-size: 13px; text-align: left; transition: background-color 100ms ease-out; } .ds-nav-row:hover { background: var(--color-paper-sunken); } .ds-nav-row.is-active { background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--color-violet) 10%, transparent); border-color: var(--color-violet); font-weight: 600; } .ds-count { margin-left: auto; font-family: var(--font-mono, monospace); font-size: 11px; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; color: var(--color-ink-soft); }

components.name: Note List Row
components.description: Timetable-dense note row: flag column, title/meta stack, mono updated time; hairline rule between rows.
components.css: .ds-list-row { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 10px; width: 100%; padding: 8px 14px; background: transparent; border: none; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--color-hairline); border-left: 1px solid transparent; text-align: left; transition: background-color 100ms ease-out; } .ds-list-row:hover { background: var(--color-paper-sunken); } .ds-list-row.is-active { background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--color-violet) 10%, transparent); border-left-color: var(--color-violet); } .ds-row-main { display: flex; flex-direction: column; min-width: 0; flex: 1; } .ds-row-title { font-family: var(--font-sans, 'Overpass', sans-serif); font-size: 13.5px; font-weight: 500; color: var(--color-ink-navy); white-space: nowrap; overflow: hidden; text-overflow: ellipsis; } .ds-row-meta { font-family: var(--font-sans, 'Overpass', sans-serif); font-size: 11.5px; color: var(--color-ink-soft); white-space: nowrap; overflow: hidden; text-overflow: ellipsis; } .ds-row-time { font-family: var(--font-mono, monospace); font-size: 11px; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; color: var(--color-ink-soft); }

narrative.overview:
joplin-lite is a working notes application drawn like a transit authority's service board: the library's sync network is a route line, every state is service status, and the work surfaces stay as standard and quiet as the platform allows. The world contributes type, palette, density, and exactly one signature move; it never contributes the layout, the navigation model, or the controls.

Density is timetable density: hairline-ruled rows, tight vertical rhythm, tabular figures for anything a machine produced. The chrome is bookended in ink navy over a map-paper ground, so the eye lands on the work between two calm bars. State color does real work and nothing else.
keyCharacteristics: Ink-navy chrome bookending a warm map-paper ground (#F6F4EE).
Overpass / Overpass Mono (Highway Gothic lineage), self-hosted.
Transit line colors as a strict state vocabulary.
Hairline-ruled, timetable-dense lists with tabular figures.
One signature: the sync line — a Beck-grammar route diagram in the status strip.

rules.name: The Service Color Rule
rules.body: Line colors carry state and only state. An idle control is never colored like an alert; a state color never decorates a heading, a border, or an icon that isn't reporting that state.

rules.name: The Two-Value Rule
rules.body: Every state color exists in a paper-safe and a navy-safe value (e.g. moss #276B43 / moss-bright #3E9B63). Never place the paper value on chrome or vice versa.

rules.name: The Tabular Rule
rules.body: Anything a machine produced — times, counts, sizes, IDs — is set in Overpass Mono with tabular figures. Mono is never used to signal "technical" on prose.

rules.name: The Hairline Rule
rules.body: Resting surfaces separate with 1px hairlines and tonal steps (paper → sunken → raised). If a new component wants a shadow, it wants a border.

dos: Do keep every state legible in the sync line before any copy explains it.
Do set all machine-produced data in Overpass Mono with tabular figures (times, counts, IDs).
Do use the state vocabulary exactly: moss = synced, route = moving/primary, signal = conflict, amber = waiting/locked, violet = selected.
Do collapse to icon-labeled chrome and stacked footer below 1024px rather than letting the shell overflow.
donts: Don't spend a state color on decoration, or use the paper-safe value on navy chrome (see the Two-Value Rule).
Don't float resting surfaces with shadows; hairlines and tonal steps are the depth system.
Don't costume controls in the transit world — navigation, buttons, inputs, and tabs stay standard web controls.
Don't place the sync line anywhere but the status strip, and never animate it when no sync is running.
